rules.name: Bounded relational chain
inputs: article nodes with unique stable IDs
each edge explicitly present in an article relations field
rules.output: ordered path candidate of 2..N article nodes
invariants: all nodes resolve to the catalog
all consecutive edges exist in the catalog
union of source references is preserved
cycles/repeated nodes are rejected within one path
output remains candidate pending semantic review
limitations: Catalog links are editorial relation candidates, not formal logical entailment.

rules.name: Shared-source grouping
inputs: two or more articles referencing the same source ID
invariants: source ID is declared in source catalog
association is not upgraded to entailment
limitations: Sharing a source does not mean the articles logically imply one another.

rules.name: Recursive composition level
inputs: explicit composition contract and invariant results
invariants: input composition must have passed human/source review
do not compose rejected or unresolved units
limitations: Not active until acceptance-state tracking and benchmark contracts are implemented.

rules.name: Exact typed-interface sequential composition
inputs: two distinct fragments that validate against the same source/span registry
the first fragment has an output whose type exactly matches a second-fragment input
every required second-fragment input must have a matching first-fragment output
rules.output: a higher-scale candidate fragment with inherited claims, merged provenance and an explicit interface trace
invariants: both parents validate against the source/span registry
a fragment cannot compose with itself
required interfaces match by exact type string
parent IDs and source provenance are preserved
inherited claims are reset to CANDIDATE
limitations: Type compatibility is a structural interface check, not semantic entailment or equivalence.
The rule does not establish causal, cognitive, mathematical or empirical claims.
The contract is tested structurally; semantic ground-truth benchmarks remain separate.
